Do you remember the first time you backed the car out of the driveway on your own? That feeling is pure freedom. But for your parents, it may have been one of the scariest moments of their lives. When you were a teenager, they had absolutely no way of knowing if you were speeding, where you had gone, when you would arrive, or how safely you were driving. "No news is good news" — they could only hope for the best until you checked in.

If you currently have a teenager who drives, you should really cherish it, because you no longer live in the era where you had to worry about those moments. Although 2026's technology has its imperfections, HeyPolo is clearly a great example of how technology is making teen driving safer and life better.

HeyPolo is more than just an upgraded version of Apple's "Find My" service

HeyPolo is a family safety app that bundles real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all into one price. The driving feature is what sets it apart most from regular location-sharing apps (such as "Find My"). Every time your child gets behind the wheel, their driving behaviour is tracked and scored, so you can see at a clear how they are performing: how fast they are driving, whether they are using their phone while driving, whether they are braking suddenly or accelerating abruptly, and whether any serious driving events are detected.

The "Driving Score" rates each trip based on their actual driving behaviour, so you no longer have to guess whether your teenager is really driving safely. You can look at the data, have a serious conversation with them if their driving performance is poor, and as their driving habits improve, the score will gradually rise. Compared with anything available to the previous generation, this is far more useful for helping newly licensed drivers build their skills.

Collision detection, arrival notifications, and more

HeyPolo can detect a collision and automatically notify you. Coupled with arrival alerts — whether your child has returned to school, the practice ground, a friend's house, or home, the system will send a triggered notification — you can move from "hoping no news is good news" to actually knowing whether they are safe. You don't have to wait until they arrive before messaging or phoning them; you can know exactly when they have arrived, and this peace of mind is priceless for parents. HeyPolo updates location every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, shared by the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription already covers your entire family, with absolutely no extra per-person charges. It also supports both iPhone and Android, so families using a mix of devices need not worry about this. HeyPolo is developed by the team behind Surfshark, so it has a solid privacy foundation. They will not sell your data; you can control what you share, who you share it with, and when you stop sharing, and all data is automatically deleted every 7 days. For a location-based app, this is indispensable when it comes to privacy.

HeyPolo comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee, no contract required — there is absolutely no reason not to give it a try.
